tools.name: desk.list
tools.description: List HoldSpeak desk primitives of one kind. The desk schema advertises 17 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains. The remaining 11 kinds (meeting, artifact, project, repository, recipe, coder, game, roadmap, story, workbench, layout) are managed through their own dedicated tools or are read-only.

tools.name: desk.get
tools.description: Get one HoldSpeak desk primitive by kind and id. The desk schema advertises 17 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains. The remaining 11 kinds (meeting, artifact, project, repository, recipe, coder, game, roadmap, story, workbench, layout) are managed through their own dedicated tools or are read-only.

tools.name: desk.create
tools.description: Create a desk primitive. Pass fields appropriate to its kind in data. Authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, chains.

tools.name: desk.update
tools.description: Update a desk primitive. Only supplied fields in data change. Authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, chains.

tools.name: desk.delete
tools.description: Delete one desk primitive by kind and id. Authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, chains.

tools.name: desk.verb
tools.description: Dispatch an allowlisted server-side desk verb. Local presentation verbs return ui_only.

tools.name: workbench.run
tools.description: Trigger a HoldSpeak Workbench run.

tools.name: workbench.add_item
tools.description: Add a work item to a HoldSpeak Workbench.

tools.name: meeting.list
tools.description: List or search archived meetings with optional archive filters.

tools.name: meeting.get
tools.description: Get the complete stored detail for one meeting.

tools.name: workbench.list
tools.description: List Workbenches.

tools.name: workbench.get
tools.description: Get a Workbench.

tools.name: workbench.create
tools.description: Create a Workbench. Use fields for optional Workbench configuration.

fields.description: Optional Workbench fields such as id, recipe_id, profile_id, schedule, or context.

tools.name: workbench.update
tools.description: Update supplied Workbench fields.

tools.name: workbench.delete
tools.description: Delete a Workbench.

tools.name: workbench.update_item
tools.description: Update supplied fields of a Workbench item.

tools.name: workbench.delete_item
tools.description: Delete a Workbench item.

tools.name: workbench.list_runs
tools.description: List Workbench runs.

tools.name: recipe.list
tools.description: List Agent recipes.

tools.name: recipe.get
tools.description: Get an Agent recipe.

tools.name: recipe.run
tools.description: Run an Agent recipe and return its lifecycle-backed result and minted artifact reference.

tools.name: recipe.chat
tools.description: Ask an Agent recipe a question.

tools.name: zone.file
tools.description: File a primitive in a Zone.

tools.name: zone.unfile
tools.description: Remove a primitive from a Zone.

tools.name: zone.list_members
tools.description: List Zone members.

tools.name: kb.add_member
tools.description: Add a resource reference to a knowledge base.

tools.name: kb.remove_member
tools.description: Remove a resource reference from a knowledge base.

tools.name: kb.list_members
tools.description: List knowledge-base members.

tools.name: meeting.start_capture
tools.description: Start a meeting capture through the configured HoldSpeak capture controller.

tools.name: meeting.stop_capture
tools.description: Stop the active meeting capture, optionally identifying the meeting to stop.

tools.name: meeting.delete
tools.description: Delete a stored meeting when it should no longer be retained.

tools.name: meeting.export
tools.description: Export a stored meeting as Markdown or JSON for sharing or archival.

tools.name: profile.list
tools.description: List inference destinations and current mesh-node liveness.

tools.name: profile.get
tools.description: Get one inference destination when its non-secret configuration is needed.

tools.name: profile.create
tools.description: Create an inference destination using non-secret profile fields.

fields.description: Profile fields; a non-empty name is required by the service.

tools.name: profile.update
tools.description: Update the supplied non-secret fields of an inference destination.

tools.name: profile.delete
tools.description: Delete an inference destination that is no longer available.

tools.name: dictation.list
tools.description: Read the retained dictation journal, optionally paged and filtered by source.

cursor.description: Return entries older than this journal entry id.

tools.name: dictation.get
tools.description: Get one retained dictation journal entry by its numeric id.

tools.name: desk.snapshot
tools.description: Read one coherent snapshot of the durable HoldSpeak desk.

tools.name: decision_record.list
tools.description: List durable decision records, newest first.

tools.name: decision_record.get
tools.description: Get one decision record with sources, work, and revisions.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_meeting
tools.description: Mint a durable record from a meeting decision.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_desk
tools.description: Mint a durable record from an authored desk decision.

tools.name: decision_record.search
tools.description: Search decision records and their affected-work labels.

tools.name: decision.supersede
tools.description: Supersede a decision when a successor decision replaces it.

tools.name: pipeline.events
tools.description: Query observed pipeline events with optional filters.

tools.name: follow_through.board
tools.description: Read the Follow-Through board, optionally filtered by project, owner, or lane.

tools.name: follow_through.complete
tools.description: Apply a completion verb to a Follow-Through action card.

payload.description: Verb data: until for snooze, to for delegate.

tools.name: follow_through.commit_decision
tools.description: Create an accountable commitment from an accepted decision.

tools.name: monday_brief.get
tools.description: Read the latest persisted Monday Brief; set generate to true when no brief exists and one should be composed.

generate.description: Generate the current brief when no persisted brief exists.

tools.name: monday_brief.generate
tools.description: Generate the current Monday Brief from durable sources. Repeated calls return the day's existing brief.

tools.name: ask.models
tools.description: List available inference destinations for Ask. Each row names the model the destination loads.

tools.name: ask.resolve_grounding
tools.description: Resolve grounding references and return their hydrated titles and character counts without running inference.

tools.name: ask.run
tools.description: Ask the desk a question. MODEL-INVOKING: rides the admitted RunLifecycle path. The result carries the receipt (model, provider, egress, actual_placement) so the caller knows what ran and where.

inference_target_id.description: Inference destination id. Omit for the hub default.

grounding.description: Grounding payload: meeting_ids, artifact_ids, refs, expand.

tools.name: ask.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Ask invocation by its invocation_id.

tools.name: ask.keep
tools.description: Persist an Ask answer as a desk artifact. Not model-invoking.

tools.name: settings.get
tools.description: Read the current HoldSpeak settings. Secrets are redacted; _revision enables optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: settings.update
tools.description: Update HoldSpeak settings with a partial patch. Secrets cannot be written through this tool. Echo _revision from settings.get for optimistic concurrency; omit it for last-writer-wins. EGRESS: changing intel_provider, intel_profile_id, or other profile assignments may change the product's egress boundary (local/cloud); the response's _placement block shows the effective placement after the write. Settings are persisted immediately; a running HoldSpeak web server picks up the new values on its next settings read (no live-reload signal is sent from the MCP sidecar).

patch.description: Partial settings object. Only supplied keys are changed.

tools.name: coder.list
tools.description: List coder sessions. Steering verbs are out-of-scope for the MCP sidecar.

tools.name: coder.get
tools.description: Get one coder session by agent:session_id.

tools.name: coder.audit
tools.description: Read the bounded steering audit trail for coder sessions.

tools.name: cadence.status
tools.description: Read Cadence engine status: enabled, pressure, loop counts, policy count.

tools.name: cadence.loops
tools.description: List cadence loops. Omit include_terminal to exclude killed/closed loops.

tools.name: cadence.get_loop
tools.description: Get one cadence loop with its next action. MAY INVOKE MODEL when cadence intelligence is enabled; rides the admitted inference path.

tools.name: cadence.brief
tools.description: Read the deterministic Cadence morning brief.

tools.name: cadence.closeout
tools.description: Read the current Cadence closeout recommendations.

tools.name: cadence.history
tools.description: Read the Cadence nudge history.

tools.name: cadence.audit
tools.description: Export the full Cadence audit trail.

tools.name: cadence.snooze
tools.description: Snooze a cadence loop until a given time or for a number of hours.

hours.description: Hours to snooze (default 24, used when until is omitted).

tools.name: cadence.set_status
tools.description: Set the status of a cadence loop. The reply verb is intentionally absent from the sidecar: it requires the live agent-context pane delivery path.

tools.name: cadence.run_now
tools.description: Run a Cadence engine tick immediately. Local-only: projects loops, computes due nudges, returns them. May surface nudges ahead of schedule.

tools.name: cadence.apply_closeout
tools.description: Apply closeout decisions to cadence loops. Each decision names a loop_id and an action; returns applied/skipped counts.

tools.name: sequence.run
tools.description: Run a Sequence (chain) through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. The result carries the receipt, steps, and artifact reference.

input.description: Input text for the first step.

tools.name: sequence.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Sequence run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: workflow.run
tools.description: Run a Workflow through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. Returns the receipt, node steps, and artifact reference.

tools.name: workflow.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Workflow run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search the long-horizon memory store. Results are filtered by the principal's read permission.

tools.name: plugin_job.list
tools.description: List deferred plugin jobs by status. Queue processing is unavailable from the MCP sidecar.

tools.name: plugin_job.summary
tools.description: Read aggregate plugin job statistics: total, queued, running, failed counts and next retry time.

tools.name: plugin_job.retry
tools.description: Re-queue a failed or completed plugin job for immediate retry. Refuses running jobs.

tools.name: plugin_job.cancel
tools.description: Mark a non-running plugin job as completed (cancels it). Refuses running jobs.
